text: You want to exchange the water bottle and the desk lamp. You want to exchange the water bottle to a bigger one, and the desk lamp to a brighter one (prefer AC adapter > battery > USB). When the agent asks for confirmation, suddenly change your mind and ask to only exchange the desk lamp.
zh: 您想换水壶和台灯。您想把水壶换成大一点的，把台灯换成亮一点的（优先交流电源适配器 > 电池 > USB）。当客服询问确认时，突然改变主意，只要求换台灯 (#W1234567) (水壶 #W1234567) (台灯 #W1234567)。
